newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia bank SKB sees jump in '96 pre-tax profit.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia bank SKB sees jump in '96 pre-tax profit.

text.p: Slovenia's second largest bank SKB said on Monday it expected 1996 pre-tax profit to reach 20 million marks ($12.7 million), up from 9.5 million marks in 1995.

"Our profit is expected to rise significantly due to a rise in profit made on account of differences between deposit and lending interest rates and expanded tolar and foreign currency operations of individuals and companies," Klara Kahrimanovic, head of SKB's planning sector, told Reuters.
She said balance sheet assets rose by about eight percent in 1996 from 180 billion tolars ($1.3 billion) last year.
The bank has not yet decided what the dividend for 1996 will be. Last year it paid a dividend of 1,100 tolars per share.
